claim.claim-text: 2. A parcel locker (200) according to claim 1, wherein the one or more foundation elements (240) are pre-cast.
3. A parcel locker (200) according to claim 2, wherein the one or more foundation elements (240) are pre-cast concrete.
4. A parcel locker (200) according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein fastening means may comprise two parts, which interlock to fixate the base plate to the foundation.
5. A parcel locker (200) according to claim 4, wherein the two parts comprise screw and bolt, riveted joints or comparable means.

6. A parcel locker (200) according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein parcel locker communication means (202) is Bluetooth or near field communication (NFC) or other standards for WPAN with the same characteristics of low power consumption and limited communication range as Bluetooth or near field communication.
7. A parcel locker (200) according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein the battery (216) is chosen amongst super capacitor, rechargeable batteries, LI-ION battery pack or comparable units.
8. A parcel locker (200) according to claim 7, wherein the LI-ION battery pack has a voltage of 7.2 V with a capacity of 19000 mAh.
9. A parcel locker (200) according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein the parcel locker (200) is without a hardwired power supply during use.
10. A parcel locker (200) according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein an electrical switch controls the mechanical lock (274).

11. A parcel locker (200) according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein the fastening means (230) being casted into the foundation element (240) as units protruding from the upper surface (242) with internal or external thread, non-protruding units, or a combination.
12. A parcel locker (200) according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein
13. Use of a parcel locker (200) according to any one of the preceding claims 1-12 for place-and-play installation including anchoring to the soil.
14. Use of a parcel locker (200) according to claim 13 for installation without a hard-wired power supply.
